$comment: Mirrors web/site's rules. `dom` was deliberately ABSENT while this app was server-only, so a stray window/document reference would fail the typecheck instead of shipping; it was added in the same change that added app/error.tsx — Next requires an error boundary to be a client component — together with removing web/dashboard from NO_CLIENT_ROOTS_OK in scripts/check-client-imports.cjs. ⚠ Differences from web/site that are NOT deliberate design, listed because the earlier comment claimed only one: target ES2022 vs ES2017, types:[node], allowImportingTsExtensions, and no .mts glob in include.
$comment_exclude: The test files used to sit here. `npm run check` runs `tsc --noEmit`, so excluding them meant the two suites this dashboard's masking guarantees rest on were never typechecked at all (code-reviewer, 2026-09-12). They are in the typecheck now.
